description: Cosina于1978年推出的旁轴相机。配备40mm/1.7, 6 elements in 4 groups.。快门速度1/8 sec -1/500 sec., B.。使用Manual, lever operated, single-stroke.。感光度ISO 25-800.。Superimposed rectangle, rangefinder-type.。

specs.曝光测光: CdS cell located above front lens element.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in X-synchronization at all speeds, manual flash compensation feature.
specs.电池: Single 1.35v mercury cell, Mallory PX 675 or equivalent.
specs.英文简介: Introduced in 1978 by Vivitar, the Vivitar 35ES is a compact fixed-lens 35mm shutter-priority rangefinder camera built to Vivitar specifications and rebadged by Cosina.
